cohort: The study included 42 pregnant women, 21 diagnosed with GDM and 21 age and BMI-matched pregnant women without GDM.
finding: Maternal serum and cord blood preptin and irisin concentrations are regulated independently in women with GDM, with maternal serum irisin levels being lower in GDM women compared to controls, while cord blood levels of both peptides were similar between groups.
cross-section timing: GDM diagnosis between 24-28th gestational weeks; maternal serum and cord blood samples taken at birth.
